root_cause: The 'Show all 4 results' button (#more) removes itself from the DOM while it has focus, causing focus to leave the dialog and breaking the :focus-within assertion.
repair_strategy: Move focus to another focusable element inside the dialog (the close button) before removing the Show all button, ensuring focus remains trapped within the dialog.
expected_accessibility_effect: Focus remains inside the results dialog after activating Show all, preserving modal keyboard navigation and the :focus-within state.
functional_risks: None; the button removal and list update remain unchanged, only focus is redirected to an existing focusable element.
verification_requirements: After clicking Show all, focus must be on a focusable element inside #results (e.g., #close).
The count must update to '4 of 4 results'.
Escape key must still close the dialog and return focus to the opener button.
Tab navigation must stay trapped within the dialog.
